name: Aim Charm
notes: A floor item (a red and white target). Only the player can pick it up: walking into it plays the item chime, floats '-5% MISS' over the player and keeps the boost until the run ends. The player's moves miss 5% less for the rest of the run: their accuracy goes up 5 points, so a 95% move never misses and a 90% one hits 95% of the time (monster aim_var). It lies at a random one of 9 spots each run (one per screen of the map, all reachable and out from under the tree tops, away from the start, the monsters' homes and the sleeping Alpha); the scene places it at the first.
